Technical support

A reply from someone who knows the method

Rapid tests fail quietly when the incubation drifts, the sample is too small or the matrix interferes. Our technical team helps you set them up right.

  • Reply within 48 hours on working days, by email or video call
  • Method and matrix guidance before you order, so you buy the right format
  • Setup guide with every kit, written for the bench and the collection point
  • Troubleshooting after delivery when results look wrong
